basics.name: Sergi Solera Monforte
basics.label: PhD Candidate & Full-Stack Research Engineer
basics.summary: PhD Candidate in AI & Education exploring the intersection of Large Language Models (LLMs) and Multi-Agent Systems. I bridge the gap between academic research and production engineering, with specialized expertise in building scalable, collaborative Intelligent Tutoring Systems (ITS) using Spring Boot, React, and Kubernetes.

work.name: Universitat de València (HiPIS Group)
work.summary: Leading research on 'Conversational Agents Integration in Intelligent Tutoring Systems'. Designing architectures for Virtual Student simulation using LLMs and Multi-Agent Systems.
highlights: Recipient of the competitive CIACIF/2021/259 Predoctoral Contract.
Developing the 'Be My Mate' framework for collaborative AI learning.
Publishing in Q1 journals (Expert Systems with Applications) and Core B conferences.

work.name: Universitat de València (School of Engineering)
work.summary: Led the architectural modernization of the 'TutorChat' platform, transitioning from a legacy monolith to a cloud-native microservices architecture.
highlights: Refactored legacy Java backend to Spring Boot and migrated frontend to React.
Orchestrated deployment using Docker and Kubernetes (MicroK8s).

education.area: Web Technologies, Cloud Computing & Mobile Apps

awards.title: València Innovation Capital Award
awards.summary: Awarded 5,000€ for excellence in R&D, recognizing the 'TutorAgents' project for its alignment with the Valencia 2030 Urban Strategy.

awards.title: Extraordinary Master's Degree Award
awards.summary: Awarded for achieving the highest academic standing (GPA 9.93/10) in the Master's in Web Technologies.

awards.title: Extraordinary Bachelor's Degree Award
awards.summary: Official recognition for the best academic record in Computer Engineering among all graduates of the year.

publications.name: A framework for adapting conversational intelligent tutoring systems to enable collaborative learning
publications.summary: Proposed a novel architecture for transforming solitary ITS into collaborative environments using agent-based orchestration.

publications.name: Be my mate: Simulating virtual students for collaboration using large language models
publications.summary: Demonstrated the first working prototype of 'TutorAgents', using Llama-2 to simulate peer-to-peer educational dialogue.

publications.name: Balancing Innovation with Ethics: Responsible Development of Multi-modal Intelligent Tutoring Systems
publications.summary: Book chapter discussing the ethical implications of deploying AI agents in sensitive educational contexts.
